verdict.rationale: BigQuery's built-in Gemini assistant generates and suggests SQL or Python code and explains existing SQL queries (bigquery-docs-5). It also turns natural language into queries, completing and summarizing code (bigquery-docs-66). It finds, joins, and queries table assets from natural-language prompts (bigquery-docs-39), and conversational analytics data agents can use custom metadata and verified queries (bigquery-docs-114). missing for 10: explicit evidence of AI-assisted fixing or debugging of broken SQL, independent or hands-on corroboration of assistant quality against real schemas.
